page.layout: One block of centred title-page text; a woodcut vignette (tree with a banner reading "NON SOLV") in the centre; library stamps at the right, not transcribed.
page.notes: The vignette shows a tree with a serpent and a banner inscribed "NON SOLV"; no further text. Manuscript annotation "1" at top right and library stamps (Biblioteca Naz. Roma, Vittorio Emanuele) are not transcribed. The date is printed in the old reversed-C form: MDCXXXIV.
